public_declarations.name: ContinuousFlexibility.Radial.n01c_exists_actual_retained_reference
public_declarations.header:
theorem n01c_exists_actual_retained_reference :
    ∃ S : SelectedTailData, ∃ K : SeedCentralCutoff,
      ∃ Cstar : ℝ, ∃ requested : ℕ, ∃ length : ℝ,
      ∃ metadata : R10aSelectedMetadata Cstar requested S,
      ∃ P : SeedRetainedPair S K 1 length, ∃ Γ : ConnectedReferenceGeometry,
        4096 ≤ S.chain.index ∧ Γ.Realizes ∧
        Γ.reference.w = P.pair.profile ∧
        RadialConstructionGeometry Γ.reference ∧
        R11aRetainedCoordinates P Γ ∧ IsRadialReference Γ.reference

public_declarations.name: ContinuousFlexibility.Statements.n01Primitive_exists_fixedWitness_properties
public_declarations.header:
theorem n01Primitive_exists_fixedWitness_properties
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {base : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hA : N01PartA D T S C) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hB : N01PartB D S C base ε)
    (hG : N01PrimitiveGeometry D T S C)
    (hE : ∀ r ∈ Ioo D.a D.b, 1 ≤ T.E0 r) :
    ∃ base' loss : ℕ, ∃ ε' : ℝ,
      base ≤ base' ∧ 0 < ε' ∧ ε' ≤ ε ∧
        N01Properties D T S C base' loss ε' ∧
          N01PrimitiveGeometry D T S C

public_declarations.header:

    ∃ S₀ : SelectedTailData, ∃ K : SeedCentralCutoff,

        4096 ≤ S₀.chain.index ∧ Γ.Realizes ∧
        Γ.reference.w = P.pair.profile ∧
        RadialConstructionGeometry Γ.reference ∧
        R11aRetainedCoordinates P Γ ∧ IsRadialReference Γ.reference ∧
        ∃ T : MaterialData, ∃ S : PhysicalSpacesData,
          ∃ C : NonlinearGeometryData S, ∃ base loss : ℕ, ∃ ε : ℝ,

public_declarations.name: ContinuousFlexibility.Statements.n01a_exists_fixedReference_primitive_context
public_declarations.header:
theorem n01a_exists_fixedReference_primitive_context (D : RadialReference)
    (hprimitive : N01RadialPrimitiveGeometry D.val)
    (henumerate : ∀ host : N01aNegativeComponent D.val → ℕ,
      (∀ J, J.interval ⊆ D.val.cells (host J)) →
      ∃ e : ℕ ≃ N01aNegativeComponent D.val, ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ m,
        |(D.val.cellIndex (host (e m)) : ℝ) - D.val.cellIndex m| ≤ B) :
    ∃ T : MaterialData, ∃ S : PhysicalSpacesData, ∃ C : NonlinearGeometryData S,
      IsMaterialData D.val T ∧ IsPhysicalSpaces D.val T S ∧
      Blueprint.N01PartA D.val T S C ∧ Blueprint.N01PrimitiveGeometry D.val T S C ∧
      (∀ r ∈ Ioo D.val.a D.val.b, 1 ≤ T.E0 r)

public_declarations.name: ContinuousFlexibility.Blueprint.exists_n01b_circleFlowGeometry
public_declarations.header:
theorem exists_n01b_circleFlowGeometry
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S}
    (hT : IsMaterialData D T) (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hPartA : N01PartA D T S C) :
    ∃ Θ : (AnnularState S × ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ,
      0 < ε ∧ N01PartB D S (circleFlowGeometry C Θ) 4 ε
